messages.subject: runApp sob console not's end
parts:
runApp under console (linux terminal) does not end even after you close the web page.

Why?

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: runApp sob console not's end
parts:
It's not supposed to terminate - it stays running and accepts any number of connections / sessions. 

-Alex
